notes.title: Polandball can into unbound
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

Just wanted to let you know that we released our second game Unbound: Worlds Apart! After 5 years of hard work and dedication, is finally available.


We really hope that you will enjoy Unbound as much as we loved creating it. This has been a great endeavor that we are so happy to have gone through, and we are so grateful to have your support all the way to the end.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814680/Unbound_Worlds_Apart/
We are really excited to see how you feel about the game so please play the game and leave us a review, it is really important to us. It will not only help us with understanding our gamers but will also help the game.

Join us today on Stream we have cookies!

notes.title: Polandball Can into Space! Custom Balls update
notes.notes:
As we promised, here is a major update on Polandball: Can into Space!

-Fix some bugs ( especially the one with the Drag perk)

-New behaviors and effects on  balls
    
-New dialogue lines between balls 

-For die hard fans. Add  3 custom balls drawn by you into the game. Every ball has different behaviour  that you may use in your strategy to conquer the Space. For the moment this feature is in Alpha state. Only up to 512x512 PNG images can be uploaded into the game . 

- "Lift off" with Space key

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/ed0420ab4a6ec3f7d0efd5e5793a1fe1de52c83f.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/86182a4f81ae7e3d1fc3daa4c3f4615a89cb24d2.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
ːmoonballː

notes.title: Polandball: Can Into Space! Patch 1.02 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce our first major update for Polandball: Can Into Space! 

Here are the new cool things that come with this update: 

- Official support for Mac OS X - Polandball can now into Apple! 
- Official support for Linux and Steam OS. 
- Gameplay controller support - you can now pilot Polandball's awesome rocket using your own personal controller. 
- Improved dialogue system - we've added a lot new cool in-game dialogues based on users suggestions. 
- Now friendly countries are indeed friendly and actually boost the rocket! 
- Added new explosion effect. Bigger, better, louder! 
- Upgrades and Attributes renamed to Rocket Parts and Perks. 
- Added Perk descriptions. You'll thank us later. 
- Various bug fixes and improvements. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/73da099531552763eee1aa3a2c27d77eb7b175f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Polandball needs you
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

For the next update we need your help. We want to add more comic messages specific to each countryball. There are a few messages right now but we need moar.

Current countries in the game:
-RomaniaBall
-GreatBritainBall
-USABall
-SerbiaBall
-BrazilBall
-FinlandBall
-BelgiumBall
-CanadaBall
-SpainBall
-MexicoBall
-FranceBall
-LatviaBall
-NorthKoreeaBall
-ChinaBall
-RussiaBall
-EstoniaBall
-SwissBall
-GreeceBall
-SweedenBall
-JapanBall
-GermonyBall
-SouthAfricaBall
-ScotlandBall

-HollandBall (Friendly)
-ItalyBall (Friendly)
-JamaicaBall (Friendly)


What you have to do:

Write in the comment section a message you think it's funny for a particular countryball when Polandball collide with it. If we like it we will going to select it to appear in the game.

Example:
RomaniaBall - Suk Ma Blod

Rules
-No ugly swears (comments will be delated)
-No more than 20 characters


The update will appear somewhere after 8 July.

ːvikingballː

PS: you can add as many messages as you want for one or multiple countryballs
